title: Onboarding assessment of the books with a draft client request list
prompt: Assess these books as if onboarding a new client: which accounts are unreconciled, which months are missing statements, what looks miscoded, and draft the document request list to send the client.

setup.q: What does the client do, who kept the books before, and what is known about their condition?
Which months should the assessment cover (default: January 1 of the current year to the last closed month)?

inputs.name: General ledger and chart of accounts
Document vault files and open document requests

steps: pull the bank accounts, the statements and reconciliations held for each month in scope, the trial balance and the general ledger
run coverage_crosswalk: each bank and balance sheet account by month against the statement and reconciliation found
run gl_hygiene over the general ledger: miscoding, wrong sign, missing descriptions, duplicates
build the document request list from the gaps (statements, loan agreements, payroll reports, contracts), one line per item with the month it covers
write the workbook and the request email draft; the draft is never sent

done.text: Every exception row cites the account id, the month and the transaction id where one applies
onboarding-assessment.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
The request email draft exists as a file for the accountant to review; it is never sent by the desk
Every request list item names the document, the month and why it is needed; unreconciled, missing statement and miscoded items are three lists, not one
